title: 2026 Youth Report: Lead with youth
discussion_signal: The post describes the youth report as a first global measurement of youth and student participation in education decision-making. It turns youth voice into an institutional measurement and accountability question rather than a symbolic consultation claim.
linked_research_question: How is youth voice measured, institutionalized, and converted into authority within education systems?
limits: The indexed post does not show the indicators or findings in detail
Measurement does not establish that participation changes decisions
